summary: Full end-to-end regression on the preview, covering Paths 1-8, the public-path wall and a code review of the charge.refunded webhook. Backend: the new test_public_paths.py passes 36/36, and test_brand_vault.py + test_events_tracking.py pass 31/31. That re-run needed the e1test-track outreach contact to be recreated, and it used the single allowed LLM call. Legacy suites (test_demo_e2e, test_outreach_crm, test_smoke, test_launch_readiness) fail 29 tests with 401. This is expected: the SEC-001 hardening refuses dev-bypass on a public host, and those suites assume the old auto-admin. It is not an app bug. Frontend: Paths 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7 and 8 work. Path 5 could not reach Stripe because the preview STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is the stub 'sk_test_stub', not the live key. KEY FINDING: the allowlist consolidation did not reach the wall the preview actually uses. Vite registers /app/viteGateWall.ts (vite.config.ts line 49). server/vitePluginApi.ts is dead code and is not registered anywhere. viteGateWall.ts still has its own stale copy of the list, which is missing /cookies, /unlock, /curriculum/one-page and /free-run/journal. Production (server/index.ts, checked on :8001) uses isPublicPath correctly.

critical.issue: The consolidation edited server/vitePluginApi.ts, but that file is not registered in vite.config.ts. The preview wall is viteGateWall() in /app/viteGateWall.ts, which still has its own duplicate PUBLIC_EXACT / PUBLIC_PREFIXES list. Drift found: /cookies, /unlock, /curriculum/one-page and /free-run/journal are public in publicPaths.ts but 302 to /try on preview. For example, anonymous GET /cookies returns 302 on preview but 200 on Express :8001. The home footer 'Cookies' link sends anonymous visitors to /try on preview. All other requested paths behave as expected, because the stale list happens to agree.

minor.issue: On preview, /app/.env has STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_stub, so every paid CTA returns 500 'Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_stub'. The redirect to checkout.stripe.com could NOT be verified. The 'Stripe is LIVE' assumption does not hold for preview. The Stripe 'ready' flag only checks that the key exists, so a stub key counts as live. The raw Stripe error message also reaches the client.

Code review only. The fix is present: INSERT IGNORE into stripe_events_processed claims event.id, and duplicates are skipped. On error, the claim row is deleted and the handler returns 500, so Stripe will retry. The table is created in the server/index.ts startup DDL (line 1853). Residual issues: (1) the INSERT IGNORE claim sits outside the try, so a DB error there causes an unhandled async rejection and the request may hang instead of returning 500. (2) Two DIFFERENT events for the same charge (two partial refunds) can still race on the read-then-update of credit_refunds; this is low risk. (3) The handler only fires if 'charge.refunded' is enabled on the endpoint in the Stripe dashboard.

On Express, /admin/* without a cookie goes to /login?next=..., not /try?from=.... The preview sends it to /try, so prod and preview differ. With the shared ow_gate password cookie, /admin/activity HTML returns 200 (data is still protected by tRPC role checks).

Any non-empty app_session_id cookie passes the HTML wall without JWT verification (e.g. app_session_id=garbage on /admin/contacts returns 200). This only exposes the SPA shell, because data stays protected by procedures. Worth noting.
With NODE_ENV=development, preview error responses include full server stack traces. This is fine in prod but visible on the public preview URL.

ui_bugs.issue: A valid non-admin member who opens any /admin/* page gets a 401 from an admin procedure. The member is then force-logged-out (POST /api/auth/logout) and sent to /login with a misleading 'Session expired... a secret was rotated' banner. Reproduced with e1test-outsider on /admin/activity. The same thing would happen on any needsAuth path when a single procedure returns 401. Also, /onboarding is in needsAuth even though it is a public path.
When checkout fails, a native alert() appears ('Checkout failed... DM Rich'). Paid tiers fall back to the reservation modal, which degrades gracefully.

integration_issues.issue: First-time visitors are redirected from / to /guide (ownology_guide_seen not set), so a stranger never sees the hero first. 12 of the ~20 /guide links are gated for anonymous visitors (/your-vintage, /cellar-brief, /knowledge, /compliance, /the-press, /quick-entry, /cellar-tasks, /vineyard, /tank-qr, /the-press/compare, /regulations, /cookies) and bounce to /try. The home page itself also links anonymous visitors to the gated /knowledge ('Explore the platform') and /cellar-brief teaser.
On 390px, a returning visitor to / is auto-redirected to /free-run once per session. This is by design, but there is no way to reach the marketing home on mobile without a second visit.

issues: The floating THEME pill (bottom-left) overlaps the bottom nav 'Learn' tab label.
The brand switcher label is still cut off ('E1 Test Brand Co · contract').
The public sign-in copy mentions 'admin tools' ('access your cellar dashboard, admin tools...').
The progress bar shows 0% on question 1 (width = i/8). Consider (i+1)/8.

passed_flows: Public wall (preview): /, /know, /demo/tour, /pricing, /curriculum/about, /curriculum/<slug>, /blog, /try, /ask, /login, /hi/<slug> return 200 anonymously. /brand, /dashboard, /admin/contacts, /admin/activity, /branding-mockup, /cellar-brief, /import return 302 to /try?from=<encoded path>, with the query string stripped. Gated pages return 200 with the ow_gate cookie (middx99) and with the JWT cookie. A wrong gate password sets no cookie.

Path 1: hero/nav CTAs reach /demo/tour, /pricing, /ask and /try?from=home-final-cta. No horizontal overflow at 390px on 9 public pages. The theme switcher changes the background (soft-cellar) and Auto resets it.

Path 2: /demo/tour?for=e1test-track greets 'Testy, meet Saltbush Hill Wines.' The Kate/Dan toggle shows/hides owner controls. The 3-step guide runs 1/3 to 3/3, then closes and shows 'Replay'. Logging shows the toast 'Demo only: nothing is saved...'. Rod's greeting was checked read-only via the demo.personalise API only (returns Rod / Patina Wines); his page was never opened.

Path 3: /know?a1=yes pre-answers Q1. Next stays disabled until a question is answered. Back keeps the answer. Every answer reveals the help text and a CTA link. The summary page lists all 8 with links plus the vault/tour CTAs. Completed anonymously only.

Path 4: /login shows Google and magic-link (invalid email blocked by HTML5 validation; no link was sent). With the JWT cookie, /api/auth/me returns 200 and /brand loads. Logout clears the cookie and /brand then returns 302.

Path 6 (UI): owner renamed the brand, added a wine spec, and invited E1TEST-contractor (stored lowercase). Contractor sees the spec read-only (no edit / new-wine / contractors tab), sees the confidential banner, and can log cellar work. Outsider cannot see the wine. After revoke, the contractor's myBrands contains only their own brand.
Path 7: 'I'm new to the site' returned the manual welcome in 0.9s (no LLM). The Home/Pro toggle persists ow_ask_audience, and pro sends mode=winemaking.

Path 8: /admin/activity lists invited people (Testy, Rod) and members, and the person timeline with sessions works. /admin/contacts renders 293 rows and 140 email chips, including email-chip-e1test-track.
action_items: HIGH: make /app/viteGateWall.ts import { isPublicPath } from './server/publicPaths' and delete its local PUBLIC_EXACT/PUBLIC_PREFIXES. Then delete server/vitePluginApi.ts, or fix its comment, because it is dead code. Fix the publicPaths.ts header comment too. Re-run test_public_paths.py and add /cookies, /unlock, /curriculum/one-page and /free-run/journal to its PUBLIC list.

Before relying on Path 5: confirm Railway has the live STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and that charge.refunded is enabled on the webhook. Preview cannot verify the checkout redirect while it uses sk_test_stub. Consider treating stub/invalid keys as not stripe-ready.
Webhook: move the stripe_events_processed INSERT IGNORE inside the try (or wrap it) so a DB failure returns 500 instead of hanging.

main.tsx authAwareFetch: do not log out a signed-in non-admin when an admin procedure returns 401. Admin procedures should return 403 (FORBIDDEN) for non-admins, or skip the redirect when /api/auth/me succeeds. Remove /onboarding from needsAuth.
Optional: review the first-visit / to /guide redirect for strangers and the gated links on /guide and home.

Legacy suites test_outreach_crm/test_smoke/test_demo_e2e/test_launch_readiness assume dev-bypass and need ADMIN_JWT cookies. WARNING: test_outreach_crm mutates the real contact 'matt-manly-spirits' (setStatus/markViewed), so do NOT run it with admin auth against the live DB. Retire it or point it at e1test slugs.

It does not cover survey_answers WHERE session_id LIKE 'e1test%' or invite_alerts slug LIKE 'survey:e1test%', so delete those manually. server/devBypass correctly refuses dev-bypass on a public host (log: SEC-001). Several docs/tests still claim the preview auto-injects an admin, and /app/memory/test_credentials.md says 'This is the current mode in the preview environment', which is stale.

Someone opened Rod's personal link before this run (admin activity shows Rod Shields · 3 visits, last at 04:29, before this test started). This agent never loaded /demo/tour?for=rod-patina-wines or /know?for=rod-patina-wines.
